_comment: Editorial company universe (PRD §3). Metadata only: industry, monitoring
priority and known aliases. Provider configuration is NOT hand-written here -
scripts/build_company_registry.py resolves it from real application URLs
observed in the two mandated seed repositories, then writes companies.json.
`backlog` entries are companies we deliberately want but could not configure
`backlog` entries are companies we deliberately want but whose own endpoint
could not be fully configured from public evidence. Those proven to run a
Greenhouse board behind their own domain (gh_jid in observed URLs) carry
candidate board tokens resolved live by the adapter; the rest fall back to
the Simplify community feed as a secondary source (PRD §4.3).
Entries pinned with source_discovered_from 'live' were configured from the
company's own careers page (which ATS it links to) and then verified against
that ATS's live API, with job links checked to resolve. Their notes cite the
evidence. Entries with status 'blocked' are recorded but not polled.
`excluded` entries are companies deliberately not monitored: the registry was
trimmed to employers at or above an AWS SDE internship in SWE resume value.
The build ignores this section; moving an entry back to `monitored` restores it.

careers page runs on Eightfold; PCSX search API answers, 98 intern postings (verified live 2026-09-27). Eightfold rate-limits this tenant after ~20-30 requests (429s observed twice); the bank-title terms ('summer analyst', 'summer associate') are dropped - Microsoft does not use them, and they returned 73 fuzzy matches - bringing a poll to ~22 requests.
careers page links to mlp.eightfold.ai; this tenant is still on the v2 API (PCSX answers 403) (verified live 2026-09-27).
jobs.uber.com links to Oracle Fusion site UberCareers; REST API answers (verified live 2026-09-27).
careers.sig.com is an iCIMS Jibe site; /api/jobs answers and job pages resolve (verified live 2026-09-27).

results page embeds its job data (AF_initDataCallback ds:1); parsed from a plain GET (verified live 2026-09-27).
higher.gs.com GraphQL API answers; campus roles read whole (titled 'Summer Analyst') (verified live 2026-09-27).
atlassian.com careers listings endpoint answers (verified live 2026-09-27). Only updated dates exposed.

metacareers.com's GraphQL needs page-issued tokens (not something to work around); monitored via the Simplify community feed as a SECONDARY fallback only (PRD §4.3) - lags the employer board and may miss roles

lifeattiktok.com's API needs signed requests (not something to work around); monitored via the Simplify community feed as a SECONDARY fallback only (PRD §4.3) - lags the employer board and may miss roles
tesla.com answers a plain request with 403 (bot protection); monitored via the Simplify community feed as a SECONDARY fallback only (PRD §4.3) - lags the employer board and may miss roles

bloomberg.com blocks automated requests (403), but the job board is hosted on Avature (bloomberg.avature.net), whose robots.txt allows /careers and publishes a sitemap of every open job. One sitemap request per poll, then a paced detail page per internship (verified live 2026-10-01: 381 open postings, no internships open that day).
roles are listed on linkedin.com behind sign-in. The Greenhouse/Lever boards named 'linkedin' are NOT LinkedIn's (test boards: a job titled '123123'). Absent from both seed feeds. Not polled.
